Maya L.: Heads-up — next release train window is Tue 09:00 UTC. Need 3 deploy owners and 2 smoke owners. Canaries for service-A and inference-runtime. Who can take which slot?
Jin P.: I can own service-A canary + smoke. Will run the post-deploy perf checks.
Ben K.: I can grab runtime canary but I have a CR gating the main rollout — expect review by EOD Mon. If it lands I’ll flip runtime to canary.
Alice H.: I can be a smoke owner for overall platform checks (infra + logs). Ping me when deploy starts, I’ll run the checklist.
David R.: I can be backup deploy owner for the 09:30 slot if anything slips. Otherwise I’ll monitor the dashboards.
Maya L.: Great — summary: Jin=service-A canary+smoke, Ben=runtime canary (pending CR), Alice=platform smoke, David=backup. Two quick asks: 1) add rollback command to the runbook, 2) confirm staged DB migration is toggled off for this run.
Ben K.: CR link: https://phabricator/redwood/D12345 — reviewers in thread. If it doesn’t clear, we’ll fallback to older runtime image and skip heavy rollout.
Alice H.: Migration flag is off in config. Verified with infra: `feature.flags.release_train_migration=false`
Jin P.: Putting the smoke checklist here for visibility:
```
- validate /health on all nodes
- run sample queries (100 qps) against canary
- check p50/p95 token latencies
- verify KV cache warmup
- confirm no error spikes in logs
```
Maya L.: Perfect. Add a small automation step: after canary succeeds, DeployBot should tag release with `release/train/1729990001` and notify channels. Ben/Alice — is the rollback command ready to paste?
David R.: Quick rollback snippet (tested in staging):
```
# rollback to previous tag
./deploy/rollout.sh --target-tag release-2026-02-18 --force --services service-a,inference-runtime
```
Ben K.: That works. I’ll keep the previous runtime image staged in the registry until +24h after rollout.
DeployBot: scheduled job created — Release train window Tue 09:00 UTC. Canary jobs queued: service-A-canary, inference-runtime-canary. Watch channel #eng-releases for live updates.
Maya L.: Thanks everyone. Action items: Ben finalize CR by EOD Mon or we do limited runtime change; Jin prepare canary artifact and smoke scripts; Alice ready for smoke run; David standby for 09:30 handoff. I’ll post the final handoff checklist in the morning. :thumbsup:
